mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month UNRATE increase above 0.5pp, indicating labor market stress, foreshadows decreased consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with triggered UNRATE increases.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO growth slows below 2% YoY, signaling supply chain constraints, S&P 500 forward returns become negative over the next 20 trading days due to decreased productivity expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in constrained periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of increasing HOUST and RSAFS, indicating robust housing and retail demand, amplifies positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with jointly increasing HOUST and RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in FEDFUNDS below 2%, coupled with a CPIAUCSL increase above 3% YoY, signals accommodative monetary policy fueling inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: PAYEMS growth above the 5-year average, indicating a strong labor market, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, regardless of the regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with PAYEMS growth above the 5-year average.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, INDPRO growth rebounding above 4% YoY, signaling restored supply chains, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in recovery periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
